title: PHS Assignment Request Form
description: Optional assignment suggestions for awarding components, study sections, scientific expertise and reviewer exclusions. Requests may not be honored.

children.label: Awarding component assignment suggestions
children.help_text:
Awarding Component Assignment Suggestions (optional)
Verify your suggested awarding component(s) (e.g., NIH Institute/Center) participate(s) in the Funding Opportunity. Use the link below to identify the appropriate short abbreviation (e.g., "NCI" for National Cancer Institute) and enter it below. All requests will be considered; however, assignment requests cannot always be honored.

Suggestions must be listed in the "Components of Participating Organizations" of the NOFO, or R&R Cover Form Box 4B must list an appropriate Notice of Special Interest.

Information about Awarding Component can be found here:
https://grants.nih.gov/grants/phs_assignment_information.htm#AwardingComponents

children.label: Study section assignment suggestions
children.help_text:
Study Section Assignment Suggestions (optional)
Enter the short study section code in the box below. Remove all hyphens, parentheses, and spaces. For example, enter "AIRT" to suggest study section "Anti-Infective Resistance and Targets", or BP10 to suggest "Small Business: Biobehavioral Processes – BP (10)". All requests will be considered; however, assignment suggestions cannot always be honored.

Information about Study Sections can be found here: https://grants.nih.gov/grants/phs_assignment_information.htm#StudySection

notes: Public reporting burden for this collection of information is estimated to average 30 minutes per response, including the time for reviewing instructions, searching existing data sources, gathering and maintaining the data needed, and completing and reviewing the collection of information.  An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a currently valid OMB control number.  Send comments regarding this burden estimate or any other aspect of this collection of information, including suggestions for reducing this burden, to: NIH, Project Clearance Branch, 6705 Rockledge Drive, MSC 7974, Bethesda, MD 20892-7974, ATTN: PRA (0925-0001).  Do not return the completed form to this address.

Study-section instructions reject literal spaces, parentheses and hyphens without rewriting input. The DAT uses BP10 and the PDF uses B10; these are source examples, not a current code-list authority. The proposed lexical constraint is stricter than the XSD and remains an explicit source difference for review.

All 13 source fixed-slot identities are preserved, including their source numbering. Section headings add no answer containers. The full public reporting burden statement is retained above rather than in an empty section that could disappear from the plan view.
All answers are optional applicant-entered suggestions. Requests are not guaranteed. There is no population, signing, attachment, registration or submission behavior in this plan.

The example uses source-supplied code examples to illustrate syntax; it does not assert that a component participates in a particular opportunity or that a study section is currently available. Program-specific guidance is still required.
risks: Awarding-component participation and current study-section availability require program guidance; no external code-list validation is claimed.
Actual library/agent review is separate from human source-policy acceptance and SGG integration.
